name: net.diofis/babelii-support
title: Babelii-Diofis Customer Support
description: Babelii help for AI agents: official FAQ, order status, product advice and support tickets.

tools.name: discover_support
tools.description: What customer service can and cannot do, the ticket rules, and whether this connection is anonymous or tied to an account.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Retrieve approved help articles about how Babelii works (ordering, payment by link, tracking, limits, policies). Answer only from the returned references; if none fit, say so and offer a ticket. Never use them as a current price, balance or order status.

tools.name: find_products
tools.description: Consult Babelii's product adviser: it interprets the customer's need (for example "paket data XL murah untuk 3 hari") and returns current catalogue recommendations with price, volume, validity, availability and a buy_url. Prices come only from this result. It never orders; the customer completes the purchase through buy_url. Limited per caller; use once per question, and a clarification in the result means ask the customer. An outside agent calling this tool is not Abel.

tools.name: order_status
tools.description: Use exactly one selector. A bare order_number gives coarse status only. A full track_url copied from the customer's checkout page unlocks the details; never invent or guess one. order_id works only for a connected account that owns the order. Never ask for passwords, PIN or OTP.

tools.name: contact_support
tools.description: Open a support ticket for staff, only after search_help did not solve the problem or the customer asks for a person. name is required; contact (phone or email) is optional. Returns a reference and, for anonymous callers, a one-time access_code: give both to the customer exactly as returned. Limited per caller; do not retry the same ticket.

tools.name: ticket_status
tools.description: Status and staff replies of a ticket. Anonymous callers need the reference and the access_code from contact_support; a connected account needs only the reference of its own ticket.
